children: USA Rare Earth supplemented its SEC filings with expanded risk factors highlighting project delays, financing needs and supply constraints.
Supplemented 10-K/10-Q risk factors via Exhibit 99.1 detailing risks to Stillwater, Blacksburg and Round Top projects.
Stillwater and Blacksburg facilities under development; no neo magnet sales yet and limited operating history.
Round Top is at exploration stage; may not reach commercial mining due to funding, permits, feasibility or technical risks.
Added to China’s export control list on June 22, 2026, limiting access to China-origin materials and harming sourcing.
Significant capital needs: incurred $298.5M net loss in 2025, accumulated deficit $387.4M; further equity/debt financing likely required.
